name: Solid Crystal Leg Shaft
summary: A Solid Crystal Leg Shaft is one of the materials Krinkle Goodsteel wants from Searing Gorge. Glassweb Spiders carry them.

sections.title: Spider's Haul
sections.body: Glassweb Spiders in Searing Gorge carry Solid Crystal Leg Shafts. Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan seeks twenty of them, along with other goods listed in his ledger. The shafts are part of a broader request reaching across several lands.

faq.q: Where do I find Solid Crystal Leg Shafts?
faq.answer: You get them from the Glassweb Spiders that live in Searing Gorge.
Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan wants twenty Solid Crystal Leg Shafts, listed in his ledger.
Krinkle Goodsteel requested the shafts among several goods listed in his ledger.
